uniques.where: ((enrollment_id IS NOT NULL) AND (lesson_id IS NOT NULL))
((contact_id IS NOT NULL) AND (course_slug IS NOT NULL))
((user_id IS NOT NULL) AND (course_slug IS NOT NULL))
((course_id IS NOT NULL) AND (slug IS NOT NULL))

checks.def: CHECK ((((email_dispatch_state IS NULL) AND (email_dispatch_attempt = 0) AND (email_dispatch_idempotency_key IS NULL)) OR ((email_dispatch_state IS NOT NULL) AND (email_dispatch_attempt >= 1) AND (email_dispatch_idempotency_key IS NOT NULL) AND (email_dispatch_idempotency_key ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9/._:-]{8,200}$'::text))))

CHECK (((email_provider_message_id IS NULL) OR (((length(email_provider_message_id) >= 1) AND (length(email_provider_message_id) <= 160)) AND (email_provider_message_id ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]+$'::text))))
CHECK (((order_code IS NULL) OR (((length(order_code) >= 1) AND (length(order_code) <= 120)) AND (order_code ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:/-]*$'::text))))

CHECK ((((amount = 500000) AND ((booking_type = 'student'::text) OR ((booking_type = 'consultation'::text) AND (duration_minutes >= 60)))) OR (((booking_type = 'student'::text) AND (((duration_minutes = 30) AND (amount = ANY (ARRAY[(500000)::bigint, (1000000)::bigint]))) OR ((duration_minutes > 30) AND (amount = (1000000 + (((duration_minutes - 30) / 30) * 500000)))))) OR ((booking_type = 'consultation'::text) AND (duration_minutes >= 60) AND (amount = (2000000 + (((duration_minutes - 60) / 30) * 700000)))))))

CHECK (((provisioning_operation_id IS NULL) OR (((length(provisioning_operation_id) >= 8) AND (length(provisioning_operation_id) <= 128)) AND (provisioning_operation_id ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:-]+$'::text))))
CHECK ((sale_status = ANY (ARRAY['Chưa liên hệ'::text, 'Đã liên hệ'::text, 'K nhu cầu'::text])))

CHECK (((provisioning_operation_id IS NULL) OR (((length(provisioning_operation_id) >= 8) AND (length(provisioning_operation_id) <= 128)) AND (provisioning_operation_id ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:-]+$'::text))))
CHECK (((char_length(TRIM(BOTH FROM title)) >= 1) AND (char_length(TRIM(BOTH FROM title)) <= 240)))
CHECK ((((status = 'completed'::text) AND (completed_at IS NOT NULL) AND (skipped_at IS NULL)) OR ((status = 'skipped'::text) AND (skipped_at IS NOT NULL) AND (completed_at IS NULL))))
